news.title: Two monster black holes could collide in just 100 years
news.summary: Astronomers have uncovered compelling evidence of two supermassive black holes spiraling toward a potentially spectacular collision at the center of galaxy Mrk 501. Depending on their masses, these cosmic giants could merge in as little as 100 years.
